full_text_zh:
[P1] 长大“干什么”
足球运动员
［比］丽斯贝特·史蕾洁斯 文/图

[P2] 好多小朋友都热爱足球，觉得它既好玩又刺激。
通常大家只是组织小伙伴们随便玩玩，
但当有人把足球踢得特别漂亮时，他就有可能成为专业球员了。
顶级的专业球员通常会在著名的球队里踢球，
带领球队捧得重要的奖杯是他的最大梦想。

[P3] 训练专用服
足球运动员上身穿运动短袖，下身穿运动短裤。
运动短袖的背后印有球员的名字和号码。
长长的足球袜包裹着护腿，
这能有效防止球员的小腿被踢伤。
足球运动员的球鞋可不止一双哦，
下雨时，他会穿上带长钉的球鞋，以防摔倒。
他所有球衣的颜色和图案都和自己的球队保持一致。
此外，他还有一套训练专用服和雨衣呢。
运动短袖
护腿
运动短裤
球袜
带长钉的球鞋
RICK
7

[P4] 只有经过艰苦的训练，足球运动员才能变得更强。
这些训练需要在专门的训练场和队友们一起完成。
教练会给球员们提供足球、颜色鲜明的训练锥以及
小球门等训练道具。
有时教练还会让球员分成两组进行对抗比赛。
足球场是一个很大很漂亮的踢球场地，
里面有能容纳很多观众的看台。
每支著名球队都有自己专属的球场，
在那里，他们可以进行自己的主场比赛。
训练场
足球
荧光背心
训练锥
足球运动包
足球场

[P5] 健康饮食

里克正在和自己的队友们进行训练。
足球场上的每支队伍都有十一名球员。
此外，还有一些替补球员。
里克是一名出色的球员，他带着球从训练锥之间跑过，
而训练锥完全没有被撞倒。
足球运动员可以用脚踢球，用腿踢球，
还可以用胸部，甚至是头部来顶球。
为了保持最佳状态，他必须多跑步多参加训练。
只有这样，他的肌肉才能变得更加结实。
此外，健康的饮食和充足的睡眠也非常重要。

[P6] 训练期间，球员们相互对抗。
通过训练，每位球员都能在球场上找准自己擅长的位置。
球员的位置不同，担负的任务也不同。
渐渐地，球员们学会了传球和带球过人，
还掌握了抢断和射门的技巧。
当比赛真正打响时，所有这些技巧都能派上大用场。

[P7] 比赛前，教练会从球队里选出十一名球员来参加比赛。
守门员负责守门，因此对方球队想要得分并不容易。
后卫是在后场踢球的球员，他们离自己的守门员最近，
主要负责防守。
而像里克这样的球员则不一样，他们是前锋。
前锋是冲在最前面的球员，他们的任务就是破门得分。
至于中场球员，他们的位置处于后卫和前锋之间。
教练在心中祈祷他的球员们获得好运。
如果发挥得好，他们肯定能赢得比赛！

[P8] 今天终于迎来了一场重要的比赛。
谁赢得比赛，谁就能捧得金灿灿的奖杯！
两支球队的球迷们都已经迫不及待了。
他们歌唱着、欢呼着，为自己喜欢的球队助威。
他们身上衣服的颜色与各自支持的球队队服颜色相同，
快看呀！他们漂亮极了！
为了让那些无法来到现场观战的球迷一饱眼福，
分布在足球场上不同位置的电视摄像机也工作起来，
捕捉着每一个精彩的瞬间。
快看！球员们入场了！

[P9] 哨子
裁判哨声响起，比赛开始了！
球从一位球员脚下飞到了另一位球员脚下。
看，里克正在控球。
几个黄队球员在里克身后紧追不舍，试图抢断。
显然，比赛双方都想得分，
都想将金灿灿的奖杯带回家。

[P10] 哦，天哪，黄队的33号球员扑了上来。
他想抢断，但犯规了。
他并没有铲到球，而是铲到了里克的腿上。
裁判吹响哨子，出示了一张黄牌。
这张黄牌是用来警示这种犯规行为的。
如果累计得到两张黄牌，裁判就会亮出红牌，
这名球员就会被罚下场，不能继续比赛了。
同时，下一场比赛，他也将不能参加。
这可是一个相当严重的惩罚哦！

[P11] 球迷们惊呆了。比赛暂停了一会儿。
还好，里克并没有受伤，黄队的33号球员伸手将他拉了起来。无疑，对于这位刚刚得到黄牌的球员来说，他的这种行为很友善。
不过，现在的形势已经对黄队越来越不利了：由于黄队的这次严重犯规实在距离自己的球门太近了，所以裁判给出的判罚是点球！
红队得到了一个破门得分的大好机会！

[P12] 裁判示意里克可以射门了。
里克准备从罚球点破门得分。
场上的球员和看台上的球迷全都屏住了呼吸。
距离比赛结束时间不多了，如果里克这一脚能够将球射入，
那么红队获胜的机会将大大提升。
助跑，射门！守门员飞扑了起来。
但一切都太晚了，球速实在太快，守门员没能扑住。球进了！
不一会儿，终场的哨声响起，红队赢得了比赛！
现场球迷们爆发出雷鸣般的欢呼声！

[P13] 胜利不只属于红队参赛的球员，更属于整支球队！
他们是同舟共济、并肩作战的战友！
他们分享着完美胜利带来的喜悦！
黄队有些沮丧，但他们仍然礼貌地和获胜队员握手，
表示祝贺。
或许你也擅长踢足球，
但你是否梦想过将来能到一支著名的球队里踢球呢？
相信，只要你刻苦训练，梦想就一定能够实现！
full_text_en:
[P1] Growing Up 'What to Do'
Soccer Player
[Belgium] Liesbet Smeets, Text & Illustrations

[P2] Many children love football, finding it both fun and exciting.
Usually, people just organize their friends to play casually,
but when someone kicks the ball especially well, they might become a professional player.
Top professional players usually play for famous teams,
and leading their team to win an important trophy is their greatest dream.

[P3] Training uniform
Football players wear short-sleeved shirts on top and shorts on the bottom.
The back of the short-sleeved shirt has the player's name and number.
Long football socks cover the shin guards,
which effectively protect the player's shins from being kicked.
Football players have more than one pair of shoes.
When it rains, they put on cleats with long studs to prevent slipping.
All the colors and patterns of their jerseys match their team.
In addition, they also have a training uniform and a raincoat.
Short-sleeved shirt
Shin guards
Shorts
Socks
Cleats with long studs
RICK
7

[P4] Only through hard training can football players become stronger.
These trainings need to be done on special training fields with teammates.
Coaches provide players with footballs, brightly colored training cones, and
small goals as training equipment.
Sometimes coaches will divide players into two groups for competitive matches.
A football stadium is a large and beautiful playing field,
with stands that can hold many spectators.
Each famous team has its own dedicated stadium,
where they can play their home matches.
Training Field
Football
Fluorescent Vest
Training Cones
Football Sports Bag
Football Stadium

[P5] Healthy Diet

Rick is training with his teammates.
Each team on the football field has eleven players.
In addition, there are some substitute players.
Rick is an excellent player; he runs with the ball between the training cones,
and the cones are not knocked over at all.
Football players can kick the ball with their feet, with their legs,
and also with their chest, or even with their head.
To stay in top condition, he must run more and train more.
Only then will his muscles become stronger.
In addition, healthy eating and sufficient sleep are also very important.

[P6] During training, players compete against each other.
Through training, each player can find their preferred position on the field.
Players have different positions and different responsibilities.
Gradually, players learn how to pass and dribble past opponents,
and also master the skills of tackling and shooting.
When the real match begins, all these skills will come in very handy.

[P7] Before the match, the coach will select eleven players from the team to participate.
The goalkeeper is responsible for defending the goal, so it's not easy for the opposing team to score.
Defenders are players who play in the backfield; they are closest to their own goalkeeper and mainly responsible for defense.
Players like Rick are different—they are forwards.
Forwards are the players who charge to the front, and their job is to score goals.
As for midfielders, their position is between defenders and forwards.
The coach prays in his heart for his players to have good luck.
If they play well, they are sure to win the match!

[P8] Today, an important match has finally arrived.
Whoever wins the match will get to hold the golden trophy!
The fans of both teams are already eager and excited.
They are singing and cheering, supporting their favorite teams.
The colors of their clothes match the colors of the teams they support.
Look! They are so beautiful!
To let fans who can't come to the stadium enjoy the game,
television cameras placed at different spots on the field are working,
capturing every exciting moment.
Look! The players are entering the field!

[P9] Whistle
The referee's whistle blows, and the game begins!
The ball flies from one player's feet to another's.
Look, Rick is controlling the ball.
Several yellow team players are chasing him closely, trying to steal it.
Clearly, both teams want to score,
and both want to bring home the shiny golden trophy.

[P10] Oh no, player number 33 from the yellow team rushed in.
He tried to tackle, but committed a foul.
He didn't kick the ball, but kicked Rick's leg.
The referee blew the whistle and showed a yellow card.
This yellow card is to warn against such foul play.
If a player gets two yellow cards, the referee will show a red card,
and the player will be sent off and cannot continue the game.
Also, he will be suspended from the next match.
This is a serious penalty!

[P11] The fans were stunned. The game paused for a moment.
Luckily, Rick was not injured, and the number 33 player from the yellow team reached out to help him up. Undoubtedly, for a player who had just received a yellow card, this act was very kind.
However, the situation was becoming increasingly unfavorable for the yellow team: since the foul was committed so close to their own goal, the referee awarded a penalty kick!
The red team now had a great opportunity to score!

[P12] The referee signaled that Rick could take the penalty kick.
Rick prepared to score from the penalty spot.
The players on the field and the fans in the stands held their breath.
There wasn't much time left in the match; if Rick could score with this kick, the red team's chances of winning would greatly increase.
Run up, shoot! The goalkeeper dived to save it.
But it was too late—the ball was too fast, and the goalkeeper couldn't stop it. Goal!
Soon after, the final whistle blew, and the red team won the match!
The fans erupted in thunderous cheers!

[P13] Victory belongs not only to the players on the red team, but to the entire team!
They are comrades who stand together and fight side by side!
They share the joy brought by a perfect victory!
The yellow team feels a bit disappointed, but they still politely shake hands with the winning players,
offering their congratulations.
Perhaps you are also good at playing football,
but have you ever dreamed of playing for a famous team in the future?
Believe it: as long as you train hard, your dream can definitely come true!
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页是绘本《长大“干什么”》的封面，主题为“足球运动员”，作者为比利时的丽斯贝特·史蕾洁斯，画面中有一个穿着红色球衣的小男孩正在踢足球。
[P2] 本页介绍了孩子们对足球的热爱，说明了从随意玩耍到成为专业球员的可能路径，并描绘了顶级球员的梦想是带领球队赢得奖杯。画面左侧是三个孩子举着奖杯，右侧是一个小男孩在后院踢球。
[P3] 本页介绍了足球运动员的装备，包括运动短袖、短裤、球袜、护腿和带长钉的球鞋，并说明了这些装备的功能和与球队的统一性，同时展示了训练专用服。
[P4] 本页介绍了足球运动员需要通过艰苦训练提升技能，教练会提供足球、训练锥等道具，并在训练场进行分组对抗；同时展示了足球场的规模和功能，以及著名球队拥有专属主场的设定。
[P5] 本页描绘了足球运动员里克在训练场进行带球绕桩等训练，强调了球员需要通过跑步和训练增强肌肉，并指出健康饮食和充足睡眠对保持最佳状态的重要性。
[P6] 本页介绍了足球运动员在训练中通过对抗练习，找到适合自己的位置，并学习传球、带球、抢断和射门等技巧，为正式比赛做准备。
[P7] 本页介绍了足球比赛前的球员选拔及场上不同位置（守门员、后卫、前锋、中场）的职责，并描绘了教练为球员祈祷好运的场景，强调了团队合作和良好发挥对赢得比赛的重要性。
[P8] 本页描绘了一场重要足球比赛即将开始的场景，球迷们身着支持球队的队服热情助威，电视摄像机准备记录比赛，球员们正入场准备比赛。
[P9] 比赛正式开始，裁判吹响哨子，球员里克在场上控球，黄队球员紧追不舍，双方都渴望得分并赢得奖杯。
[P10] 比赛中，黄队33号球员在抢断时犯规，铲到了对方球员里克的腿，裁判出示黄牌警告，并解释了累计两张黄牌将被罚下场并停赛的规则。
[P11] 比赛中黄队33号球员犯规铲倒红队球员里克，裁判出示黄牌后，因犯规地点靠近自家球门，判罚点球，红队获得破门良机，黄队球员主动扶起对手，展现友善举动。
[P12] 红队球员里克在点球大战中成功射门得分，帮助球队在比赛结束前锁定胜局，现场球迷欢呼庆祝胜利。
[P13] 本页描绘了红队赢得比赛后，队员们共同庆祝胜利，黄队队员虽感沮丧但仍礼貌祝贺的场景，并鼓励读者通过刻苦训练实现踢球梦想。
